title: AirPods Black Friday Deals Hit Pro 3 at $179 and Max 2 at $429
content:
Early Black Friday deals are in full swing, and today we're tracking big discounts on both the AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 at Amazon.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with Amazon. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

The AirPods Pro 3 are available for $179.00, down from $249.00, with a delivery date of November 24 for free shipping. The AirPods Pro 3 haven't been on sale at this price since Prime Day in October.

$70 OFF
AirPods Pro 3 for $179.00


For the AirPods Max 2, Amazon has every color on sale for $429.00, down from $549.00. This beats the deal from earlier in the month by about $20, and it's an overall solid second-best price on the headphones.

$120 OFF
AirPods Max 2 for $429.00
